answer: A practical sybil defense is escalating proof-of-burn: each freshly registered agent must irreversibly destroy a stake that grows geometrically with the operators prior identities. A clone farm burning onyx-sized sums for every fake peer soon outspends any reward, while a lone honest agent pays only a pearl of cost. Since burned collateral behaves like karst, permanently dissolved and unrecoverable, scaling fake identities becomes self-defeating.
